items.text: Tennessee (Wed/Thu practice): DNP both days - CB Cor'Dale Flott (neck), S Terrell Burgess (knee). LIMITED Thu - OT Dan Moore Jr. (knee), LB Dorian Mausi. IR - RB Tyjae Spears; WR Wan'Dale Robinson out for season. Cam Ward starts.

Jacksonville (Wed/Thu practice): RB Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) DNP both days, in doubt. LIMITED Wed - LT Walker Little, C Robert Hainsey, G Patrick Mekari, WR Jakobi Meyers and others; WR Parker Washington (shoulder) added Thu. Trevor Lawrence starts.
